supportResident.title: How can we help you?
supportResident.faqDescription: Browse the FAQs or start a chat with AI.
supportResident.aiDescription: Ask a question and we’ll point you in the right direction. For now this is a basic guide.
supportResident.aiGreeting: Hi. I’m the BuildingFex assistant. How can I help?

supportResident.chatGreeting: Hello! How can we help you today?
supportResident.faq1Answer: A platform to run condominiums and residential buildings—common areas, collections, maintenance, and resident communications—with the same experience on this site and in the web app.
supportResident.faq2Question: How do I pick a subscription plan?
supportResident.faq2Answer: Choose based on how many apartments your building has. Amounts are in Peruvian soles (PEN) and billing is monthly. If you're unsure at a range boundary, contact us via Support.
supportResident.faq3Question: How do I contact the team?
supportResident.faq3Answer: Write to us from the Support chat: the assistant answers from your building's rules and meeting minutes and, when needed, hands your question to the board or building administration.
supportResident.faq4Answer: We follow solid security practices and clear terms. Legal details are in the terms of service linked in the footer.
supportResident.sessionMissing: Sign in as a resident to use chat.
supportResident.loadChatsError: Could not load conversations. Check your connection and try again.
supportResident.noConversations: No conversations yet. Use the button above to start one with building administration.
supportResident.faq5Question: How do I pay my maintenance fee?
supportResident.faq5Answer: Open Finanzas, select the pending fees and tap Pay; the charge is processed by Mercado Pago. Reconciliation is automatic: once the payment is approved your balance updates and the receipt is available in Finanzas. If the payment is declined your balance does not change and you can try again.
supportResident.faq6Question: How do I book a common area?
supportResident.faq6Answer: In Servicios choose the area, the date and a free time slot, then confirm. Overlapping bookings or bookings above the area's capacity are not allowed. Each area's rules and hours are set by your building's rules.
supportResident.faq7Question: How do I report an issue?
supportResident.faq7Answer: In Incidencias tap New incident, describe what is happening, where (tower, floor, unit or common area) and whether it is urgent, and attach a photo if you can. You can follow its status and the assigned provider's comments.
supportResident.faq8Question: How do I register my guests?
supportResident.faq8Answer: In Generación create a QR code for your guest and share it; building staff validate it at the entrance.
supportResident.faq9Question: What can the AI assistant answer?
supportResident.faq9Answer: It answers only from your building's current rules and meeting minutes and the BuildingFex user guide, and it cites the source. If it finds no documentary basis, if you ask for a person, or if the building reached its plan's monthly query limit, it hands your question to the board or building administration.
supportResident.faq10Question: How do I change the language or check my account?
supportResident.faq10Answer: In Settings you can switch between Spanish and English and review your profile. You sign in with your administration's invite link; if it expired, ask for a new one.
